evidence: http.py:285-292: marked_send copies the message, filters headers with k.lower() != b"x-sqllens-auth" (bytes vs bytes), and appends a (bytes, bytes) tuple. The ASGI spec defines http.response.start headers as an iterable of [byte string, byte string] pairs, and Starlette/FastMCP emit bytes tuples. Headers are independent, so appending after content-length is valid; uvicorn accepts any extra header. The tuple unpacking also works for list pairs.

http.py:273-276: __call__ reads scope["type"] directly and, if != "http", forwards to inner with no marker and no warning (warning/marker only after line 277). Same pattern at lines 331, 366; _SessionManagerLifespan branches on scope["type"]=="lifespan" at 448. ASGI spec guarantees scope["type"] is always present.

http.py:249-250 wraps _PathNormalizer (which holds /healthz,/readyz short-circuits) in _InsecureAuthMarker inside TrustedHostMiddleware, so every Host-accepted http request passes marked_send (285-292), which sets x-sqllens-auth on http.response.start (replacing any existing). Streaming/SSE still emit response.start, so they are marked. Starlette error responses inside FastMCP go through send. Insecure mode means no real authenticator, so no non-AuthError exception path bypasses the marker (only AuthError caught at 373). Logging at 277-283 fires on first request (None) and when >=60s since last; asyncio single-threaded with no await between check and set, so no race. _send_json (724-743) adds x-content-type-options: nosniff to all fixed JSON health/readiness/401 responses.

http.py:249-250 wraps marker inside TrustedHostMiddleware (marker only when insecure_bind). _InsecureAuthMarker (266-294): non-http scopes pass through (274-276); logs on first request (_last_warning None) and again only when >=60s elapsed (278-283); stamps x-sqllens-auth on http.response.start (285-291). Absolute check: hostile input is a Host-rejected request, which is rejected by the outer guard before reaching the marker, so it is unmarked and unlogged, matching the doc. Every http.response.start in the package is at 733 (_send_json, adds nosniff at 737) or the marker; _send_json callers are health, readiness and _send_401 (the only auth error path, line 374), so all are covered.

http.py:240-242 _build_asgi_app_bare enforces the unauthenticated non-loopback policy regardless of transport, and build_asgi_app (183) and run (257) go through it, so factories and launchers are covered, along with the CLI check at cli.py:126. Line 249 wraps the app in _InsecureAuthMarker when insecure_bind is true. That class adds the x-sqllens-auth header (285-291) and logs a warning at most once per 60s (277-283), which gives the response markers and throttled reminders. _send_json (724-743) always sets x-content-type-options: nosniff. It is the only emitter of JSON responses in the module (health, readiness and the other call at 772). Counterexample input tried: an auth failure response. The _send_json call at 772 is the only other JSON path, and it uses the same function.

With mode=none, insecure=True and host 0.0.0.0, _InsecureAuthMarker wraps the normalizer (http.py:249), and marked_send appends x-sqllens-auth: insecure-loopback-override (http.py:285-292).
